en.headline: Audit Commission urges faster recovery of HK$131 million in defaulted student loans
en.dek: The report found 9,515 default cases representing 4.2 per cent of loan amounts, with legal action not begun in nearly half after pandemic deferrals.
body: The Audit Commission has called on the Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency to speed up recovery of more than HK$131 million in defaulted student loans after reviewing five post-secondary and tertiary assistance schemes.

As of the end of September, the commission said there were 9,515 cumulative default cases, equal to 4.1 per cent of repayment accounts and 4.2 per cent by loan amount. Undemanded principal and arrears totalled HK$695.1 million.

The agency responsible said the figures reflected a five-year period during and after the Covid-19 pandemic, when supportive measures suspended debt-recovery legal action. The commission noted that legal proceedings had not started in almost half the cases after deferral and urged faster action, especially where borrowers or guarantors had not responded for more than a year.
The agency has pledged to introduce automated alerts and is exploring further measures. The report was tabled in the Legislative Council on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 審計署促加快追計1.31億元拖欠學生貸款
zh.dek: 報告指截至9月底有9515宗拖欠個案，佔貸款額4.2%，近半數個案在疫情延期後仍未展開法律行動。
body: 審計署審查五項專上及大專學生資助計劃後，促請在職家庭及學生資助事務處加快追計超過1.31億元的拖欠學生貸款。
截至9月底，累計拖欠還款個案9515宗，佔還款帳戶4.1%，按貸款額計算拖欠比率4.2%。未到期本金及拖欠款項合計6.951億元。
負責機構表示，數字反映新冠疫情期間及之後五年的情況，當時政府推出支援措施暫停債務追計法律行動。審計署指出，近半數個案在延期後仍未展開法律程序，並促請加快行動，尤其是貸款人或彌償人超過一年沒有回應的個案。
機構已承諾引入自動化提醒，並正研究進一步措施。報告於星期三提交立法會。
